newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Golden Harvest, STIC in China JV.
newsitem.headline: Golden Harvest, STIC in China JV.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd (STIC) said on Tuesday it had formed a joint venture with Golden Harvest Multiplex (GHM) to invest in a cinema complex in Shanghai, China.
The new 50-50 venture, Golden-STIC Investment Holdings, would invest up to US$2.0 million in a six-screen, 1,300-seat multiplex cinema in Shanghai, the companies said in a joint statement.
GMH is a Singapore unit of Hong Kong's Golden Harvest Entertainment Holdings Ltd.

"This investment exemplifies STIC's strategy to broaden our leisure and lifestyle business through investments into new areas and reduce our dependence on the Singapore market," the statement quoted STIC chief executive Tay Siew Choon as saying.
The first four screens were expected to open in August with the remaining two opening by the end of the year.
If successful, the venture would be expanded to more sites in Shanghai and other major cities across China, it said.
Tay said cinemas offered "tremendous growth potential as they provide good, steady cashflow once they break even".
Golden Harvest on Monday joined Citicorp and the state-owned Television Corporation of Singapore to launch a US$30 million fund to invest in Chinese movies.
